subject: mRNA-1273 Drug Substance manufacturing
statement: Manufacturing process consists of six sequential steps: mRNA Synthesis at 38.7°C using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT, mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C, LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at 16 mL/min flow rate, Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C, Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at ambient temperature, and Fill-Finish with vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 conditions. All steps resulted in PASS status.
supporting_quote:
Step 1: mRNA Synthesis, T7 RNA Polymerase IVT, 38.7°C, PASS
Step 2: mRNA Purification, Tangential Flow Filtration, ≤5°C, PASS
Step 3: LNP Formulation, Microfluidic Mixing, Flow rate: 16 mL/min, PASS
Step 4: Diafiltration, Buffer Exchange to PBS, ≤5°C, PASS
Step 5: Sterile Filtration, 0.22 µm filter, Ambient, PASS
Step 6: Fill-Finish, Vial filling (0.5 mL), Aseptic ISO 5, PASS
